phases.objective: Promote the three reviewed Spec 014 SQL candidates into the governed runtime migration directory with exact executable-statement parity, zero-risk preflight, checksum and statement-count evidence, and a fail-closed dependency chain, without authorizing or applying any migration.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Runtime Migration Promotion Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Three ordered runtime migrations match the reviewed candidate statements exactly, pass repository preflight with zero risks, expose stable checksum and statement-count evidence, and remain unapplied and unauthorized.
steps: Load the three contract-local reviewed SQL candidates and their promoted runtime migration files.
Split executable SQL with the same repository parser used by governed migration authorization.
Require exact executable-statement parity for every wave.
Run repository migration preflight and require pass with zero risk findings.
Verify exact tables, views, disabled tool seeds, and absence of destructive or secret-bearing SQL.
Compute SHA-256 checksum and statement count for each promoted migration.
Validate the ordered dependency chain from foundation to control plane to execution evidence.
Prove no authorization bootstrap, migration execution, live database access, provider dispatch, credential access, deployment, or Production mutation occurred.
assertions: Wave 1 creates exactly four foundation tables.
Wave 2 creates exactly six control-plane tables and depends on Wave 1.
Wave 3 creates exactly five execution/evidence tables, three views, and three disabled tools and depends on Wave 2.
All promoted executable statements equal their reviewed contract-local candidates.
Every migration preflight passes with zero risk findings.
No migration is authorized, dry-run, applied, or read from a live database in this PR.

phases.objective: Operational apply requires separately merged main, authorization bootstrap, dry-run, typed confirmation, and live readback.
Failure recovery belongs to the separately governed apply and reconciliation cycle.
No database or provider canary is executed by promotion.
Production migration apply and runtime mounting remain separately governed and blocked.
